g.title: j3795061139
g.text: The issue at hand, Drifter, is that I do not know. If I knew the answer, I would not be tearing myself apart with such an internal debate.

g.title: j4273127707
g.text: I shall summarize, though I am shocked you have avoided his rants on the topic. He is quite overeager to share them at every opportunity.

g.title: j2948715949
g.text: But as such, now is therefore, as "good" a time as any. It intrigued me that you seemed to side with Roathe in your belief that the Indifference was not a true god.

g.title: j177983155
g.text: Or potentially two, depending on how you wish to interpret the situation. Though I suppose that is indeed the heart of my dilemma.

g.title: j2111787610
g.text: However, I should... start at the beginning. You will not understand precisely why this particular topic is of such import to me if you do not have some context...

g.title: j2159491397
g.text: He believes that the Indifference is not a god of the Void, in any sense of the word, and was in fact crafted by Entrati and all those who interacted with it afterwards -

g.title: j1151994706
g.text: I am a Brother of Lua. I have dedicated my life to her worship. All my life, I have believed this.

g.title: j249043019
g.text: - สร้างมันขึ้นมาจากวอยด์ผ่านสิ่งที่คุณเรียกว่า "การทำให้แนวคิดกลายเป็นรูปธรรม"

g.title: j206426097
g.text: And throughout all my years since arriving to the church, I have held fast to my faith - to what has been the firm knowledge that my suffering, my pain, and my visions -

g.title: j905867743
g.text: Much in the same way you created Duviri, I believe.

g.title: j2310107317
g.text: - have been in her service. Have been in her name. And have been for her purpose.

g.title: j14589658
g.text: That was... until "Cardinal Dimanche" revealed himself to be Albrecht Entrati.

g.title: j1802341996
g.text: And he told us the truth of who he was, the tale of his misdeeds with the Void, and all that came of it. More specifically... all that came out of it.

g.title: j1973713628
g.text: The Indifference.

g.title: j2041161199
g.text: And?

g.title: j1337790381
g.text: Correct. He told us of the sneering thing that greeted him, of the fingers he retrieved from that place that resembled his laboratory.

g.title: j2121112077
g.text: He told us of his descent in the seriglass bell into the emptiness. Of the place that resembled his laboratory.

g.title: j1992743288
g.text: Moreover, he told us of the great dread he felt, knowing he had unleashed a thing that could follow him not just through space, but through time.

g.title: j3669801777
g.text: A god of nothingness. A thing that must be contained. A creature of which he had pieces, who would scratch at the walls to be freed.

g.title: j838215270
g.text: A terrible and consuming god who was, and also was not, already free.

g.title: j1553787161
g.text: What do you mean?

g.title: j1684673917
g.text: "Was" and "also was not" already freed?

g.title: j810568003
g.text: Time is... tangled, for someone such as I, in the state I am now in. It is hard to describe. I have made a poor attempt to explain this once, and I have failed miserably.
